reuse.why: Changes only the existing getRangedAmount and getExpectedAmount that every consumer already calls; no new logic paths.

duplication.why: The rule change is two one-line edits in the shared definitions; caller edits are comment updates only.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, where the tree defines the expected-amount rule.

scope.why: Rule edits, matching comment updates and updated tests; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Math.min and amount - threshold state the 'lowest allowed value' rule directly in one place.
